activationClustering.distance: 1 - signed Pearson correlation over all trace rows
activationClustering.linkage: Average linkage, cluster distance equals mean pairwise channel distance.
activationClustering.ties: Merge lexicographically first minimum pair of cluster minimum columns.
activationClustering.labels: Cluster IDs ordered by smallest original FIRE column.
activationClustering.layer: W4 final classifier Linear input, after its preceding GELU.
activationClustering.sampling: All 616 recorded decisions, including repetitions, in their original order. Same development trace used to select these 256 weights.
activationClustering.interpretation: Co-activation on these three ViZDoom episodes only. Cluster labels do not identify game features or causal mechanisms; other states and k may differ.

controllers.name: Tactical readout
controllers.routing: LEFT, RIGHT and FIRE scores add to the native logits. BACKWARD is independent.

controllers.name: Combat readout
controllers.routing: When active, the readout selects from four actions and compares two movement scores. The first three scores also receive the scaled prior logits.

controllers.name: Facing guard
controllers.routing: One shared weight adds its feature-weight product to BACKWARD and subtracts it from FORWARD.

provenance.quantization: Every original Linear matrix rebuilt and byte-compared with the W4 archive.
provenance.equality: Exact numeric equality after signed-code × FP16 group scale, decoded to FP32. Denominator is unique registered scalar parameters, including frozen ones.
